hypothesis.statement: Requiring actual band-0 validity and its publication before inverse admission removes the documented corrupt output without new errors or hangs.
hypothesis.falsified_if: The guarded arm still produces the early-reader state, still corrupts, or only passes by changing scheduling so much that the positive modal result is lost.

patch_requirement.admission_predicate: consumer proceeds only when band 0 is actually valid and published, not when valid == started
patch_requirement.patch_location: disposable private copy outside tracked git

arms.description: unmodified original decoder on the same private copy
arms.purpose: baseline reproduction under the registered conditions

controls.description: single worker, where the race is not expected to occur
controls.expected: no early-reader state in either arm

controls.description: forced-preemption barrier or deliberately injected publication state
controls.expected: guarded arm refuses admission, unguarded arm reproduces the symptom
controls.purpose: negative control that must not be skipped or reported as PASS

controls.expected: first failure preserved, no stale READY

controls.description: bounded fresh-process stress arm, 60 processes as in the recorded witness
controls.expected: bounded completion, every child terminated within the deadline

positive_checks_retained: modal output digest unchanged in the unguarded arm

verdict_rules.CURE_CONFIRMED: guarded arm removes the documented corruption, preserves the modal result, and produces zero unexplained errors or hangs in every registered control
verdict_rules.NO_EFFECT: guarded arm still reproduces the early-reader state or the corrupt output under matched conditions
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE_TIMING: the guard changes scheduling far enough that positive evidence cannot be attributed, or coverage is incomplete; must not be reported as a cure
verdict_rules.BLOCKED_UPSTREAM_PATCH: no correct publication synchronization is feasible without invasive edits to frozen original source
